changelog: Fix: Button spacing audit — all main logging modals now meet minimum 12px gap between tappable buttons. Morning Check-In symptom grid, Yes/No pairs, and waking-hours selectors raised from 6-8px to 12px. Log Symptom recent chips, Log Fluid quick-add row, and Log Activity BP-before button also corrected. Senior touchscreen usability fix. No font or button size changes.
